page.layout: One printed page. A calendar table in three parts: left a column of month names, day-of-month numbers and letters; centre a narrow "Dies" column of numbers 1 to 30 with the Nisan heading and the feast notes; right a column of short notes in roman and italic. Running head at top centre with a Hebrew subtitle line. Page number top left. Signature "B 3" and a faint "CALEND." label at the foot.

main_text.head: נִיסָן Mensis septimus.
main_text.l: 1637. | | 7. NISAN di. 30. | Hic est primus in anno sacro.
Martij. 16 | 1 | Iejunium. | Characterē habet hoc anno 5. 6. 62.
18 | 3 | Sabbathum. | Hic mensis in libris Mosis Abib appellari videtur Exodi 34.
24 | 9 | | 10. moritur Maria Mosis soror. Eligitur Agnus Paschalis.
25 | 10 | Iejunium. Sabb. | Quoties Sabbathum occupat diem jejunij, transfertur jejunium.
30 | 15 | פסה PASCHA. | Agnus mactatur die 14. inter duas vesperas. Solemnitas Paschatis die 15. Exodi 12.
10 | 26 | Iejunium. | Die 26. moritur Iosua filius Nun. Iosuæ 34.

page.notes: The "Dies" column header is set vertically. Hebrew words (נִיסָן, פסה) are copied as printed. Left-hand letters A and the faint "CALEND." mark at the foot are as seen. The faint background text from the reverse side (show-through) is left out.
